newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Cavallo optimistic on IBM bribe case.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Cavallo optimistic on IBM bribe case.

text.p: Argentine courts are will successfully get to the bottom of alleged bribery charges connected to a $250 million contract beween IBM and state-owned Banco Nacion, said former Economy Minister Domingo Cavallo on Monday.

Speaking after making a declaration before investigating judge Adolfo Bagnasco, Cavallo told reporters: "The information I gave will help unravel not only the IBM-Nacion case, but a whole system, a modus operandi, associated with the theme of computers for some time." Bagnasco has indicted 11 people in connection with the case.
Cavallo also appeared on Monday as a witness before a judge in relation to a bank collapse during last year's financial crisis.

The former minister, at the center of a storm over his allegations that government ministers covered up corruption and manipulated judges, said he was only called to testify in order to damage his image.
"It was a total waste of time, a strategem so that I appear in the newspapers," he said.
